title: Conduit
description: A declarative composition of HTTP API calls, evaluated as a single async function. Prose reference: docs/syntax.md. Published to the npm package root as conduit.schema.json; the canonical source is spec/schema/conduit.schema.json in the repository.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editor tooling. Not used at runtime.

name.description: Non-empty identifier for the conduit, used in error messages.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what the conduit does.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema validating the input before any step runs. Omitted, non-object, or uncompilable schemas are skipped without failing the run.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema validating the result of output_transform. Same leniency as input_schema.

steps.description: HTTP requests to run. Independent steps run concurrently; `needs` both orders a step and exposes another step's response to it.

output_transform.description: JSONata expression producing the final output, evaluated once every step has completed.

$comment: Two rules cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and are enforced only at parse time: duplicate step `id`s are rejected, and a `needs` entry naming a step that does not exist is rejected. A dependency cycle is also not detectable here — it surfaces at run time as `Cycle detected in conduit steps`.

step.$comment: Deliberately NOT additionalProperties:false. The runtime silently ignores unknown step keys, so a typo here fails quietly rather than loudly. Contrast with the top level, which rejects unknown keys.

id.description: Unique step id. This step's parsed response is exposed as steps.<id> to later steps and to output_transform.

url.description: JSONata expression evaluating to an absolute request URL. A relative path is an error.

method.description: HTTP method. Defaults to GET when omitted.

headers.description: Header name to JSONata expression. Values are coerced with String(...), so an expression yielding undefined sends the literal text `undefined` — append `?? ""` to guard.

query_transform.description: JSONata expression evaluating to the query parameter object. REPLACES any query string already present in url. Array values serialize as repeated `key[]=` parameters.

body_transform.description: JSONata expression evaluating to the request body. Ignored on GET. Serialized as JSON with content-type: application/json; an expression yielding undefined sends no body.

needs.description: Ids of steps this one depends on. May name a step declared later in the file. A step reading steps.<other> MUST list <other> here, or it reads undefined.

cache_ttl.description: GET-only response cache lifetime in seconds; 0 or omitted disables caching. The key is method + url + query string sorted by key. HEADERS ARE NOT PART OF THE KEY — do not cache a URL whose response varies by credentials.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema validating this step's parsed response. Same leniency as input_schema.
